description: Image Description: The image is a simple, minimalistic graphic consisting of a single white arrow pointing to the right. The arrow is composed of a straight line with a triangular head, resembling a greater-than symbol (>). It is set against a solid black background, creating a high-contrast visual. There are no additional objects, text, or elements present in the image. The design is clean and symbolic, often used to indicate direction, progression, or navigation in user interfaces.
